Advanced knowledge of labor law compliance and a proven track record of managing and updating labor law posters across multiple locations.
Deep proficiency in SharePoint and report generation.
Exceptional data entry skills with a consistent emphasis on accuracy and detail.
Substantial experience in billing within a compensation and benefits context.
Strong organizational abilities and a proven capacity to manage multiple tasks concurrently with minimal oversight.
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with various departments and vendors.
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred.

You will work closely with internal stakeholders and vendors on a daily basis, staying in regular contact across departments to keep compensation and benefits operations running smoothly. The role involves hands-on work in Workday and other People Operations systems, and you will be a go-to contact for questions, requests, and issue resolution.
cond_0222.responsibilities:
Labor Law Update: Stay current with federal and state labor law requirements and ensure that all company labor law posters are updated timely and displayed appropriately across all locations.
SharePoint/Intranet Report Updates: Manage and fulfill requests for report updates in SharePoint, staying in regular contact with internal stakeholders to ensure accuracy and timeliness of the data provided.
Workday Ticketing: Serve as the first point of contact for the Workday ticketing system, actively engaging with users to resolve issues and manage requests efficiently to maintain smooth operation within the People Operations platform.
Billing: Oversee the billing process related to compensation and benefits, communicating directly with vendors and internal teams to ensure accuracy in invoicing and payments, and resolving discrepancies as they arise.
General Data Entry for COBRA: Execute meticulous data entry tasks for new hires and terminations in the COBRA system, ensuring all information is accurate and up to date.
Data Entry for Compensation and Benefits Systems: Provide data entry support for various compensation and benefits systems and vendors, contributing to the integrity and reliability of our People Operations database.
Other duties as assigned.
cond_0222.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum of 2 years of experience in compensation and benefits administration within People Operations or Human Resources.
Proven experience with People Operations systems, preferably Workday.
Knowledge of labor law compliance and experience with updating labor law posters.
Strong skills in data entry with an emphasis on accuracy and detail.
Experience in billing within a compensation and benefits context.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills to interact with various departments and vendors.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
Proficiency with SharePoint and report generation.
Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks concurrently.
